Unhandled WebGLUnavailableError when WebGL context creation fails

Regression of chipi/orrery#523 (closed 37d ago).

**Signal:** `WebGLUnavailableError: WebGL is unavailable on this device` (source: glitchtip, fp: `glitchtip:ORRERY-1I`)
**Code version:** `gha-393a5a52`  _(frames resolve against this revision)_

**Symptom:** Orrery throws an uncaught WebGLUnavailableError on devices/browsers without WebGL support, captured as an error event in Glitchtip.

**Area:** WebGL rendering / error handling

**Acceptance criteria (intent-cited):**
- When WebGL context creation fails, the app handles the error gracefully—showing a fallback UI or a clear message—without throwing an unhandled exception.  _(intent: code-invariant)_

**Evidence:**
- event_detail shows custom WebGLUnavailableError thrown in THREE.WebGLRenderer context creation, uncaught in app code (staging, count=1)
